_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Packaging Test Plan
summary: The Packaging Test Plan identifies the assembly to be tested, test set-up, equipment, procedures, data sheets, criteria, critical conditions, and schedule, and provides information to evaluate contractor packaging test planning.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Packaging Test Plan identifies the assembly to be tested, test set-up, test equipment, test procedures, sample data sheets, test criteria, critical test conditions and overall test schedule.
3.2 The Packaging Test Plan provides information required to evaluate and monitor the contractor's planning for testing applicable to the packaging of an item.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.2 The Packaging Test Plan is related to the following DIDs:
a. Packaging Plan DI-PACK-80455
b. Packaging Test Report DI-PACK-80457
c. Packaging Cost Analysis DI-PACK-80458
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Packaging Test Plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Packaging Test Plan content shall be as follows:

children.title: Title Page.
children.content: The title page shall include the contractor's name and address; contract number; project number; security classification; item, equipment or purchase description identification; and document title.

children.title: Identification.
children.content: Identify each system, subsystem, equipment, assembly, item, and component to be tested.

children.title: Test Description.
children.content: Identify and describe each test set-up at each level of test and include diagrams and sketches necessary to illustrate each test set-up.

children.title: Test Equipment.
children.content: Identify and describe all required test equipment including special jigs and fixtures.

children.title: Test Procedures.
children.content: Identify and describe each test procedure including test sequence, test parameters, and test participants.

children.title: Test Data Sheets.
children.content: Identify, describe, and include copies of sample test data sheets which illustrate test data to be documented and available for delivery for each level of test.

children.title: Test Acceptance Criteria.
children.content: Identify and describe the test acceptance criteria at each level of test and describe the procedures to be followed in the event of malfunction or failure.

children.title: Critical Test Conditions.
children.content: Identify and describe critical or unusual tests and test conditions.

children.title: Test Schedule.
children.content: Delineate a comprehensive and detailed test schedule.

children.title: References.
children.content: All appendices, drawings, sketches, illustrations, and tables shall be identified and shall be referenced in the appropriate elements of the plan.
